lines.1: Above all, the rooftop offered a spectacular view.
lines.2: The sea stretched wide before us.
lines.3: Behind us, we could look out over the whole city of Matsukasa.
lines.6: Crab frolicked in the strong sea breeze, her short skirt fluttering in the wind.
lines.7: Her shadow stretched long across the roof.
lines.8: The whole scene felt somehow dreamlike.
lines.9: 「Watching a sunset always makes me want to play guitar.」
lines.10: 「Is this okay, Subaru? Hasn't your club started already?」
lines.11: 「A little while won't hurt. Everyone knows I do whatever the mood takes me.」
lines.12: 「Oh, look. There's somebody else up here.」
lines.13: A lone figure stood in a corner of the rooftop, watching the sinking sun.
lines.14: She was tall--around a hundred and seventy centimeters.
lines.16: The figure turned and stared at us.
